title: Pharmacy Restock Schedule: Restocking Charge on Delivery & Pickup Services Orders Cancelled Before Dispatch
content:
The restocking charge retained on a Delivery & Pickup Services order cancelled before dispatch depends on the cancelled order's value, as its order record shows it. The restocking charge retained is kept back from the refund of the cancelled order's speed fee.

| Cancelled order's value | Restocking charge retained |
|---|---|
| $150.00 or more | $1.00 |
| at least $75.00 but below $150.00 | $0.50 |
| below $75.00 | none |

## Edges (hypothetical order values)

| Order value | Restocking charge |
|---|---|
| $74.99 | none |
| $75.00 | $0.50 |
| $149.99 | $0.50 |
| $150.00 | $1.00 |
| $318.40 | $1.00 |
